subject.title: 5.26 supervisor mode + dual-plist install: 30s EADDRINUSE loop + silent-fail unset order

question: Should the durable fix for this launchd dual-plist loop clear launchd markers in generated gateway wrappers, add doctor/install repair for the legacy node LaunchAgent, or defer runtime changes and land docs first?
rationale: The source-backed bug is credible, but the permanent fix changes macOS managed-service marker semantics and may alter node LaunchAgent availability for existing operators.

options.title: Land docs first, keep runtime open
options.body: Land the open runbook if maintainers accept the node-service warning, and keep this issue open for wrapper generation plus doctor/install hardening.

options.title: Change generated wrapper behavior
options.body: Update generated gateway LaunchAgent wrappers to unset launchd markers after sourcing the env file, with focused tests and macOS upgrade proof.

options.title: Doctor repair only
options.body: Teach doctor to detect the dual-plist marker-risk setup and offer a repair while leaving service generation unchanged for now.

recommendation.title: Land docs first, keep runtime open
recommendation.body: Land the open runbook if maintainers accept the node-service warning, and keep this issue open for wrapper generation plus doctor/install hardening.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent code-review and commit history on the LaunchAgent wrapper and service-env boundary that the decision would change.
